[EVENT] User is thinking of going on a trip soon.

[EVENT] User has purchased a portable power bank from Amazon for $20.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant acknowledges the user's current power bank and provides factors to consider when choosing a portable power bank for travel.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Jackery Titan 20000: 20,000mAh, multiple USB ports, rugged design ($40-$50)  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Aukey Power Bank 26800: 26,800mAh, multiple USB ports, compact design ($30-$40)  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Eggtronic Power Bank 20000: 20,000mAh, compact, multiple USB ports, built-in cable ($30-$40)  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant advises to check reviews, warranty, and brand reputation when choosing a power bank.  
[PREFERENCE] User is looking for a compact and lightweight power bank.  
[EVENT] User expresses interest in the Mophie Powerstation Mini.  
[PREFERENCE] User asks if the Mophie Powerstation Mini supports fast charging.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant confirms that the Mophie Powerstation Mini supports fast charging but notes limitations based on the model.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant explains that the standard model has a USB-A port with up to 2.4A output, while the Mini XL supports USB-PD up to 18W.  
[FACT] Mophie Powerstation Mini has a capacity of 10,000mAh.
